user.title: Generic Water Heater Setup
user.description:
Creates a virtual water heater that controls a switch using a temperature sensor.

Modes:
- electric: heats normally using target temperature and tolerances.
- performance (Boost): prioritizes heating.

Smart Eco is controlled with a dedicated select entity and uses the template below as the allow/block condition for heating.

Enable Debug Logging to capture detailed decision paths and state transitions in Home Assistant logs.

data_description.eco_mode_template_condition: Boolean template used by Smart Eco policy. Smart Eco policy is controlled by a select entity with modes Off, On until next manual control, Auto Resume after Delay, and Always ON.
data_description.nominal_power_w: Nameplate wattage of this heating element, used for fleet load admission. Nameplate is used rather than a power sensor because power sensors poll far too slowly to gate a switch-on decision. Leave at 0 if unknown, but note that a heater with no nominal power is invisible to the fleet power budget. Update this if the element is rewired or its power selector is changed.
data_description.fleet_stagger_seconds: Minimum spacing between this heater switching on and any other Generic Water Heater instance switching on. Stops several heaters stepping onto a shared inverter or generator in the same instant when they react to the same trigger. A blocked heater waits and retries; it is never skipped. The largest value set on any instance applies to the whole fleet. 0 disables staggering.
data_description.fleet_power_budget_w: Maximum combined nominal power that all Generic Water Heater instances may have switched on at once. 0 disables the budget. The smallest non-zero value set on any instance applies to the whole fleet. A heater is never blocked while no other instance is drawing, so this can only prevent a combined overload, never leave you without hot water entirely.
data_description.smart_eco_manual_off_resume_hours: In Smart Eco Mode 'Auto Resume after Delay', manual OFF pauses Smart Eco policy for this many hours before automatic resumption.
data_description.enable_debug_logging: Logs detailed runtime diagnostics, including mode transitions, heating/idle state transitions, threshold decisions, eco condition updates, manual overrides, and switch command/cooldown reasoning. Disabled by default.
data_description.enable_max_temp_history_sensor: Adds a sensor under the same device that tracks the highest recorded temperature over the last 7 days. Disabled by default.
